basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a newbie to Reddit and Animal Crossing enthusiast based in Oregon. I spend my free time customizing my island and trading items with fellow players. Besides gaming, I'm fascinated by bus conversions and love watching anime, especially intriguing series like Wonder Egg Priority. I work part-time as a barista and enjoy sketching in my downtime. I'm currently single and typically online in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Although new to Reddit, I have developed a keen interest in Animal Crossing and bus conversions through online forums and YouTube channels. My gaming knowledge is primarily self-taught through countless hours of gameplay and community interactions.
